decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The Appeal Inspector has considered that the proposed demolition of 
 this bungalow and the replacement by a pair of semi detached 
 houses, because of their position, design and appearance, would be 
 acceptable having due regard for the site characteristics of 101 The 
 Grove and complementary to the visual amenity of the locality, and   
 would not be detrimental to the amenities of the adjoining and 
 neighbouring properties.  The development is in accordance with 
 Adopted UDP policies ENVB.1.1 (New Development),  ENVB 2.2 
(Conservation Areas), H 4.2,(Residential Density),  H 6.3 (Infill 
Development) and T 5.3 (Vehicle Crossovers and Hardstandings) of 
the Council's Unitary Development Plan.
Condition : 2 - The building, the subject of this consent, shall not be demolished before a contract for the carrying out of work of redevelopment of the site has been let.
description: Demolition of existing dwellinghouse and garage
